knowledge:
- key_parameters: refBuild=Sets the reference genome version for Homo sapiens ("hg18", "hg19", or "hg38") in readMaf ;; use.indel.ccf=Logical parameter in readMaf; set to TRUE if the CCF file contains INDELs ;; class=Specifies the mutation classification method ("SP" for shared pattern or clonal status) in classifyMut and plotMutProfile ;; withTumor=Logical parameter in mathScore; set to TRUE to estimate the MATH score within a tumor based on merged VAF ;; use.ccf=Logical parameter in mutCluster and mutHeatmap; determines whether to use CCF instead of VAF for clustering or heatmap visualization ;; method=Specifies the phylogenetic tree reconstruction method ("NJ", "MP", "ML", "FASTME.ols", or "FASTME.bal") in getPhyloTree ;; CT=Logical parameter in mutTrunkBranch; set to TRUE to classify C>T mutations at CpG sites versus other sites ;; signaturesRef=Specifies the reference signature matrix ("cosmic_v2", "exome_cosmic_v3", "nature2013") or a user-provided matrix in fitSignatures
- alternatives: mobster=The documentation notes that the neutral evolution analysis (testNeutral) has been superseded by the mobster package ;; phangorn=Used internally via treedist to compute distances between phylogenetic trees in compareTree
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have multi-region sequencing (MRS) data from tumor biopsies and want to evaluate intra-tumor heterogeneity, reconstruct phylogenetic trees, infer metastatic seeding patterns (monoclonal vs. polyclonal), and analyze mutational signatures.
- pitfalls: Tumor_Sample_Barcode must be completely consistent across all input files (MAF, clinical, CCF, and segmentation files) ;; The Chromosome field format in the MAF file and CCF file must match exactly (either both numeric or both starting with "chr") ;; mutCluster only focuses on heterozygous mutations within copy-number neutral and loss of heterozygosity (LOH)-free regions when clustering VAFs, as copy number aberrations alter read fractions ;; Low VAF/CCF populations might represent a mixture of subclonal mutations from admixed polyphyletic lineages rather than a single clone ;; Ensure the genome version of GISTIC2 results is consistent with the refBuild of the Maf/MafList object

workflows.name: data_import_and_profiling
workflows.intent: Import somatic mutation, clinical, CCF, and copy number segmentation data to classify mutations and visualize mutational and CNA landscapes.
input: CRC_HZ.clin.txt (Clinical data file with sample and patient IDs)
workflows.stages:
1. Load somatic mutations, clinical data, and CCF data using readMaf to create a Maf object.
2. Classify mutations based on shared patterns using classifyMut.
3. Visualize the mutational landscape of driver genes across regions using plotMutProfile.
4. Read copy number segmentation and GISTIC2 files using readSegment.
5. Visualize the CNA landscape across samples using plotCNA.
workflows.code:
maf.File <- system.file("extdata/", "CRC_HZ.maf", package = "MesKit")
ccf.File <- system.file("extdata/", "CRC_HZ.ccf.tsv", package = "MesKit")
clin.File <- system.file("extdata", "CRC_HZ.clin.txt", package = "MesKit")
# Maf object with CCF information
maf <- readMaf(mafFile = maf.File,
               ccfFile = ccf.File,
               clinicalFile  = clin.File,
               refBuild = "hg19")  
driverGene.file <- system.file("extdata/", "IntOGen-DriverGenes_COREAD.tsv", package = "MesKit")
driverGene <- as.character(read.table(driverGene.file)$V1)
mut.class <- classifyMut(maf, class =  "SP", patient.id = 'V402')
head(mut.class)
plotMutProfile(maf, class =  "SP", geneList = driverGene, use.tumorSampleLabel = TRUE)
# Read segment file
segCN <- system.file("extdata", "CRC_HZ.seg.txt", package = "MesKit")
# Read gistic output files
all.lesions <- system.file("extdata", "COREAD_all_lesions.conf_99.txt", package = "MesKit")
amp.genes <- system.file("extdata", "COREAD_amp_genes.conf_99.txt", package = "MesKit")
del.genes <- system.file("extdata", "COREAD_del_genes.conf_99.txt", package = "MesKit")
seg <- readSegment(segFile = segCN, gisticAllLesionsFile = all.lesions,
                   gisticAmpGenesFile = amp.genes, gisticDelGenesFile = del.genes)
seg$V402[1:5, ]
plotCNA(seg, patient.id = c("V402", "V750", "V824"), use.tumorSampleLabel = TRUE)

workflows.name: ith_measurement
workflows.intent: Quantify and visualize intra-tumor heterogeneity (ITH) within tumors and genetic divergence between regions.
workflows.stages:
1. Estimate mutant-allele tumor heterogeneity (MATH) scores using mathScore.
2. Calculate the area under the curve (AUC) of the cumulative density function of CCFs using ccfAUC.
3. Cluster mutations in one dimension by VAFs or CCFs using mutCluster.
4. Calculate Wright's fixation index (Fst) between regions using calFst.
5. Calculate Nei's genetic distance between regions using calNeiDist.
workflows.code:
# calculate MATH score of each sample
mathScore(maf, patient.id = 'V402')
AUC <- ccfAUC(maf, patient.id = 'V402', use.tumorSampleLabel = TRUE)
names(AUC)
# show cumulative density plot of CCF
AUC$CCF.density.plot
mut.cluster <- mutCluster(maf, patient.id = 'V402', 
                          use.ccf = TRUE, use.tumorSampleLabel = TRUE)
clusterPlots <- mut.cluster$cluster.plot
cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = clusterPlots[1:6])
# calculate the Fst of brain metastasis from V402
calFst(maf, patient.id = 'V402', plot = TRUE, use.tumorSampleLabel = TRUE, 
       withinTumor  = TRUE, number.cex = 10)[["V402_BM"]]
# calculate the Nei's genetic distance of brain metastasis from V402
calNeiDist(maf, patient.id = 'V402', use.tumorSampleLabel = TRUE, 
           withinTumor  = TRUE, number.cex = 10)[["V402_BM"]]

workflows.name: metastatic_routes_and_neutrality
workflows.intent: Infer metastatic seeding patterns (monoclonal vs. polyclonal) and evaluate neutral evolution.
workflows.stages:
1. Perform pairwise CCF comparison of mutations between sample pairs using compareCCF.
2. Calculate the Jaccard similarity index (JSI) using calJSI to evaluate clonal seeding.
3. Test whether tumor subclonal mutant allele frequencies follow neutral evolution using testNeutral.
workflows.code:
ccf.list <- compareCCF(maf, pairByTumor = TRUE, min.ccf = 0.02,
                       use.adjVAF = TRUE, use.indel = FALSE)
V402_P_BM <- ccf.list$V402$`P-BM`
# visualize via smoothScatter R package
graphics::smoothScatter(matrix(c(V402_P_BM[, 3], V402_P_BM[, 4]),ncol = 2),
                xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1),
                colramp = colorRampPalette(c("white", RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "BuPu"))),
                xlab = "P", ylab = "BM")
  
## show driver genes
gene.idx <- which(V402_P_BM$Hugo_Symbol %in% driverGene) 
points(V402_P_BM[gene.idx, 3:4], cex = 0.6, col = 2, pch = 2)
text(V402_P_BM[gene.idx, 3:4], cex = 0.7, pos = 1,
       V402_P_BM$Hugo_Symbol[gene.idx])
title("V402 JSI = 0.341", cex.main = 1.5)
JSI.res <- calJSI(maf, patient.id = 'V402', pairByTumor = TRUE, min.ccf = 0.02, 
                  use.adjVAF = TRUE, use.indel = FALSE, use.tumorSampleLabel = TRUE)
names(JSI.res)
# show the JSI result
JSI.res$JSI.multi
JSI.res$JSI.pair
neutralResult <- testNeutral(maf, min.mut.count = 10, patient.id = 'V402', use.tumorSampleLabel = TRUE)
neutralResult$neutrality.metrics
neutralResult$model.fitting.plot$P_1

workflows.name: phylogenetic_and_signature_analysis
workflows.intent: Reconstruct phylogenetic trees, perform functional enrichment of branch-specific mutations, analyze mutational signatures, and visualize trees with mutational heatmaps.
workflows.stages:
1. Reconstruct phylogenetic trees using getPhyloTree.
2. Compare trees constructed with different methods using compareTree.
3. Extract branch-specific mutations using getMutBranches for downstream pathway enrichment.
4. Analyze trunk vs. branch mutation spectrum using mutTrunkBranch.
5. Generate a 96-trinucleotide mutation matrix using triMatrix.
6. Fit mutational signatures and estimate contributions using fitSignatures.
7. Plot original and reconstructed mutational signature profiles using plotMutSigProfile.
8. Visualize the phylogenetic tree annotated with mutation heatmaps using plotPhyloTree and mutHeatmap.
workflows.code:
phyloTree <- getPhyloTree(maf, patient.id = "V402", method = "NJ", min.vaf = 0.06)
tree.NJ <- getPhyloTree(maf, patient.id = 'V402', method = "NJ")
tree.MP <- getPhyloTree(maf, patient.id = 'V402', method = "MP")
# compare phylogenetic trees constructed by two approaches
compareTree(tree.NJ, tree.MP, plot = TRUE, use.tumorSampleLabel = TRUE)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(clusterProfiler)
# Pathway enrichment analysis
V402.branches <- getMutBranches(phyloTree)
# pathway enrichment for private mutated genes of the primary tumor in patient V402
V402_Public <- V402.branches[V402.branches$Mutation_Type == "Private_P", ]
geneIDs = suppressMessages(bitr(V402_Public$Hugo_Symbol, fromType="SYMBOL", 
                              toType=c("ENTREZID"), OrgDb="org.Hs.eg.db"))
KEGG_V402_Private_P  = enrichKEGG(
  gene = geneIDs$ENTREZID,
  organism = 'hsa',
  keyType = 'kegg',
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
)
dotplot(KEGG_V402_Private_P)
# load the genome reference
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19)
mutClass <- mutTrunkBranch(phyloTree, CT = TRUE, plot = TRUE)
names(mutClass)
mutClass$mutTrunkBranch.res
mutClass$mutTrunkBranch.plot
trimatrix_V402 <- triMatrix(phyloTree, level = 5)
# Visualize the 96 trinucleodide mutational profile
plotMutSigProfile(trimatrix_V402)[[1]]
# reconstruct mutational profile of V402 using COSMIC V2 signatures
fit_V402 <- fitSignatures(trimatrix_V402, signaturesRef = "cosmic_v2")
# Compare the reconstructed mutational profile with the original mutational profile
plotMutSigProfile(fit_V402)[[1]]
# Below plot shows cosine similarities between the mutational profile of each group and COSMIC signatures
library(ComplexHeatmap)
ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(fit_V402$V402$cosine.similarity, name = "Cosine similarity")
# A phylogenetic tree along with binary and CCF heatmap of mutations 
phylotree_V402 <- plotPhyloTree(phyloTree, use.tumorSampleLabel = TRUE)
binary_heatmap_V402 <- mutHeatmap(maf, min.ccf = 0.04, use.ccf = FALSE, patient.id = "V402", use.tumorSampleLabel = TRUE)
CCF_heatmap_V402 <- mutHeatmap(maf, use.ccf = TRUE, patient.id = "V402", 
                                 min.ccf = 0.04, use.tumorSampleLabel = TRUE)
cowplot::plot_grid(phylotree_V402, binary_heatmap_V402,
                   CCF_heatmap_V402, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1.5, 1, 1))
